_comment: Every Phone Assured content asset we create or curate for the listing/social. Prevents duplication (check 'angle' before building) and tracks approval. status: draft -> approved -> live. Nothing goes live without William's approval.

assets.headline: ONE CLIP. PHONE SECURED.
assets.basis: Benefits = product features (anti-theft/drop/loss) + the real 1-yr warranty doc; Amazon image policy (no price/badge/contact) via amazon-image-compliance.md linter
assets.note: v1 basic blue-header design — superseded by v2-callouts (pro annotated style)

assets.headline: KEEPS YOUR PHONE SECURE (annotated product callouts)
assets.basis: Research-backed spec (confabulator design brief): Anton condensed display + Montserrat body, SVG leader-line callouts, brand #0B3D91, one-message, 4 callouts, WCAG-contrast, 2000px. Claims truthful (zinc-alloy carabiner, 27in cord, quick-release buckle from existing product copy). Compliance linter passed.

assets.headline: NEW HERO A: single black clip on pure white
sources: PA Black 1/Packof1.jpg (clip isolated via sharp crop, text removed)
assets.basis: Amazon 2026 main-image spec (RGB 255,255,255, >=85% fill, 2000px, NO text/logos). Verified by inspection: product-only, white, no text. Listing is NOT suppressed (validated, 0 issues) — this is a CTR lever (CTR fell 0.78%->0.60%), not a suppression fix.

sources: PA Black 1/Packof1.jpg (clips isolated via sharp crop, '1-PACK' phone+text removed)
assets.basis: Same Amazon 2026 spec; good as main or as a secondary. Verified product-only/white/no-text by inspection.
